parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-20250514",
  "max_tokens": 4096,
  "messages": [{
    "role": "user",
    "content": "You are an expert SEO copywriter. Rewrite the following page copy to optimize for the target keywords while matching their search intent.

## Page URL
{{ $json.page_url }}

## Page Title
{{ $json.page_title }}

## Current Copy
{{ $json.current_copy }}

## Target Keywords (with intent)
{{ $json.target_keywords.map((kw, i) => `- ${kw} (intent: ${$json.keyword_intents[kw] || 'informational'})`).join('\n') }}

## Instructions
1. Rewrite the copy to naturally incorporate ALL target keywords
2. Match the search intent for each keyword:
   - Transactional: Include CTAs, pricing signals, action-oriented language
   - Commercial: Include comparisons, benefits, social proof
   - Informational: Include explanations, how-to steps, educational content
   - Navigational: Ensure brand mentions and clear page identity
3. Maintain a {{ $json.tone }} tone
4. Optimize the title tag (under 60 chars) and meta description (under 155 chars)
5. Include H2/H3 subheadings that incorporate keywords
6. Keep paragraphs short (2-3 sentences max)
{{ $json.word_count_target ? '7. Target approximately ' + $json.word_count_target + ' words' : '' }}

## Output Format (JSON)
{
  "optimized_title_tag": "...",
  "optimized_meta_description": "...",
  "optimized_h1": "...",
  "optimized_copy": "... (full rewritten copy with HTML heading tags)",
  "keywords_used": ["list of keywords naturally incorporated"],
  "intent_alignment": {"keyword": "how intent was addressed"},
  "changes_summary": "brief description of what changed and why"
}

Respond ONLY with valid JSON, no markdown fencing."
  }]
}
